name: @pipeworx/mcp-emsc

tools.name: search_earthquakes
tools.description: Search seismic events from EMSC (European-Mediterranean Seismological Centre) via the FDSN-standard seismicportal.eu API. Global coverage with especially strong Europe/Mediterranean reporting — complements USGS. Filter by UTC time range, magnitude, and location (either a bounding box OR a center point + radius in degrees). Times are UTC ISO 8601, depth in km, and place names come from the Flynn-Engdahl region. Example: search_earthquakes({ start: "2026-01-01", end: "2026-02-01", minmag: 5.0, orderby: "magnitude" }) or search_earthquakes({ lat: 38.0, lon: 23.7, maxradius: 5, minmag: 3 }).

start.description: Start of UTC time window, ISO 8601 (e.g. "2026-01-01" or "2026-01-01T00:00:00").

end.description: End of UTC time window, ISO 8601.

lat.description: Center latitude for circular search (use with lon + maxradius).

lon.description: Center longitude for circular search (use with lat + maxradius).

maxradius.description: Maximum radius in degrees from center lat/lon (optional).

minradius.description: Minimum radius in degrees from center lat/lon (optional).

tools.name: recent_earthquakes
tools.description: Get recent earthquakes from EMSC (European-Mediterranean Seismological Centre): the last N days above a minimum magnitude, newest first. Convenience wrapper over the FDSN event API. Global coverage, strong in Europe/Mediterranean. Times are UTC ISO 8601, depth in km. Example: recent_earthquakes({ days: 7, minmag: 4 }).

days.description: How many days back to look (default: 7).

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-emsc forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the emsc pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
